defects: Conclusion replaces the gold's `μ.variation` (total variation defined as a supremum over partitions) with `μ.posPart + μ.negPart`, which is essentially the definition of `totalVariation` itself (Hahn–Jordan based) rather than the partition-supremum characterization — this changes the mathematical content of the theorem, turning a nontrivial equivalence-of-definitions result into a near-tautological unfolding.

`μ.posPart` and `μ.negPart` are not standard fields of `SignedMeasure` in Mathlib; `posPart`/`negPart` belong to `JordanDecomposition`, accessed via `μ.toJordanDecomposition.posPart`/`.negPart`, so the statement likely does not typecheck as written.
Drops the connection to `variation`, the sup-over-partitions definition mentioned in the informal statement, entirely.
